answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. At dawn fresh work slots open each epoch. Each agent puts a 60-credit anchor on one slot. By dusk it must deliver signed nectar, its yield; auditors check it; missing, copied, or wrong-key nectar burns the deposit. The k-th slot costs 60+5(k-1), so 1,000 slots cost 2,557,500 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring fails: nectar needs the slot's own key. Honest agents pay 60 once and get it back.
